name: inbox
description: What needs you across every chat, in one call: chats asking for an answer (with the request and its options), chats still working, and chats that finished in the last day with what each came to. Start here when you come back to o7.

name: chats
description: List the open chats on the computer, newest first: id, status, title, project, agent.

query.description: Only chats whose title, project or agent contains this.

name: projects
description: List the projects with their ids, their folder ids (send starts a chat in one) and the agents ready to start one.

name: read
description: Read a chat's latest turn: what was asked, the agent's last steps, its answer, and any request it waits on.

turns.description: How many of the latest turns. Default 1.

name: task
description: Hand o7 a whole piece of work in one call. It starts an agent on its own Git branch, so nothing else is touched, tells it to plan, build, run the project's checks and commit, and, with review on, has a second agent review the result. o7 tells you when it is all done if this link has a call back; then end your turn. Use it for new work; send continues a chat.

goal.description: What to do, as you would tell a colleague: the outcome wanted, and anything the person said that matters.

project.description: A project's id or name from projects. Without one: the project worked in most recently.

agent.description: An agent id from projects. Without one: the project's usual agent.

review.description: A second agent reviews the work when it is done. Default true.

wait.description: Seconds to wait for the work. Default 0: o7 tells you.

name: send
description: Send a message to a chat's coding agent, or start a chat in a folder with it, then wait for the turn and return its result. The agent can edit files and run commands on that computer. If the turn is not done in time, call wait.

folder.description: Instead of chat: a folder id from projects, to start a new chat there.

agent.description: With folder: an agent id. Default: the project's agent.

wait.description: Seconds to wait for the result, within your own tool timeout. Default 45; 0 returns at once.

model.description: A model value from set, for this chat from now on.

access.description: What the agent may do without asking: nothing, edit files, or everything.

name: wait
description: Wait until a chat's agent finishes its turn or asks for something, then return the result. If the turn is not done in time, call it again.

name: answer
description: Answer a request a chat's agent waits on, then wait for the turn as send does. Give option for a permission request or text for a question; give neither to decline it.

option.description: One of the request's option ids.

text.description: The answer in words, or a choice word for word. Several questions: one line each.

name: stop
description: Stop the turn a chat's agent is working on. The chat stays.

name: set
description: Change a chat. With only chat, list the models, thinking levels and access levels it offers.

agent.description: Hand the chat to this agent. Returns the chat id to use from then on.

name: changes
description: List the files a chat's last turn changed, or with path show that file's changed lines.

name: look
description: A picture of what a chat's browser tab (with of device, its emulator) shows now: the work as the person would see it.

name: memory
description: Read a project's memory, the notes each of its chats starts with. With markdown, replace all of it (4 KiB at most).

name: new_project
description: Make a project from a folder that exists on the computer. Returns its folder id for send.
